//: OPS-003: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Before anything git here cannot undo (deleting untracked files or data, dropping uncommitted work, changing databases, cloud resources or repository settings), show the command and get approval for it; after damage, stop and report.
why: Stash-and-reset sequences, rollbacks and git clean have destroyed work that git could not bring back.
enforced_by: Claude Code sandbox and auto mode classifier
to_add: sandboxes turned on everywhere, since Grok Build's is off by default
deletion protection the session cannot purge
a hook on destructive commands that also catches their alternate spellings
